name: okr-doing-agent
description: Install and migrate a local OKR Doing system, or turn completed work into copy-ready Daily Doing Markdown.

interface.shortDescription: Install or migrate OKR OS, and draft Daily Doing Markdown.
interface.longDescription: OKR Doing Agent installs a personal Logseq OKR Doing system, inventories and migrates old OKR assets safely, and turns completed work into copy-ready Daily Doing Markdown.
interface.defaultPrompt: 用 OKR Doing Agent 帮我安装或迁移 OKR 系统，或者把刚完成的工作整理成可直接复制的 Daily Doing。
